issue.title: Reading-view ledger links gain status rings and miss In Progress marks
issue.description: Proposed by bob-cli-gf.3 notes #2 and #3; triaged by bob-cli-gf.land. The real Obsidian 1.15.0 Athena scratch-vault run reported in bob-cli docs/off-clock-link-chips.md (e9deb7f8) paints status rings on dedicated Reading-view ledger links, including the unchipped parser control, and omits the progress half-ring on the lunch-wip link. Live Preview is correct. The committed e2e harness (bob-plugins 46b25c6) skips those assertions explicitly, so its 88/88 pass does not establish these marks. Both surfaces call progressMarkReadingContext; audit that shared recognition and Reading postprocessor/cache timing first, without assuming a proven common root. The gf change only added an allowed chip class to that classifier; it did not alter renderProgressMarksIn or the ring reading pipeline. Source scope predates gf and no active epic has a credible causal connection. Restore dedicated-ledger exclusion for status rings and the current-day open-row progress mark, then replace the documented skips with assertions. Preserve prose rings, historical row semantics, and off-clock chips. Sized large because the real-DOM/timing root cause is not yet localized and requires investigation before implementation.

task_type_fields.impact: Reading view misrepresents planned or logged tasks by painting prose-style status rings and hiding In Progress; current e2e skips leave these production gaps uncovered.
task_type_fields.repro: Run xvfb-run -a node scripts/obsidian-off-clock-link-chips-e2e.cjs against an isolated scratch vault with Tasks available (never the live vault). Inspect Reading-view parser and lunch-wip rows and report.skipped: ledger status rings also paint on unchipped parser; lunch-wip lacks .bob-progress-mark. Compare Live Preview and chips toggled off. See bob-cli-gf.3 notes #2-4 and docs/off-clock-link-chips.md Live verification.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-gf.3 live verification found two pre-existing ledger-mark gaps; landing review found no matching task, and these should be repaired without holding off-clock chips.
